title: Holidays are coming
objectives: express future plans with going to

elements.content: Lesson Objectives for Holidays are coming:
express future plans with going to; talk about holiday celebrations
Review key terms and target language below:
Key terms: holiday, travel, plan, celebrate
Choose the correct structure for future plans:
Read the short passage below (recycling introduced vocabulary):
Holidays are coming! I am going to travel with my family. We plan to celebrate together.
Listening Task: Listen to your teacher / audio prompt and answer the comprehension question.
Tell your teacher what you are going to do for your next holiday or day off.
Today you practiced: express future plans with going to, talk about holiday celebrations.
